script:
We still can't reconstruct a single first disclosure from those accounts. But we can hear the progression from a private breach of trust to a public campaign, and the explanations Angela gave along the way.

There was one more warning in Petty Space about just how far she was prepared to go.

That is an extraordinary amount of leverage for someone to hold over former friends: years of direct messages, waiting to be published if the argument escalates.

And the screenshots were not the only way the private relationship became public. Angela was also beginning to describe me in terms that could ruin a reputation.

Angela accused me of abusing women and called me a predator. She also accused me of passing around women's nude photographs and creating sexual AI material.

I want to examine those claims because the consequences reached beyond me. Sav had shared private concerns with Angela about our relationship; now those conversations were being used in the public case Angela was making.

Earlier, in an unrelated February dispute about Mellow Demon and an AI image, you heard Angela warn against a male witch hunt. She said serious labels should be reserved for real abusers, not used to settle scores.

Months later, on September 7, she explained why she sometimes chose the word predator instead of pedophile. The distinction she drew was deliberate.

Eleven days later, in Logan Black Unmasked, the language was directed at me.

An accusation that serious has consequences even before anyone knows whether it's supported. Angela's description of choosing the word for legal purposes tells us how she approached the language; it does not establish that the label was accurate.

Then came the allegations about intimate photographs.

In a September 15 broadcast Angela said I was sending women's nudes around the app.

She separately accused me of making sexual AI material.

But there was a woman who knew the context behind at least one of the photographs Angela was discussing. It was Sav.
